title: A drawing can use fonts the user provides
body:
acre embeds its fonts in `crates/acre/src/render.rs`: JetBrains Mono, Noto Sans in three faces, and, after the math issue, a math font. `font` takes one of the names `mono`, `sans`, `sans-bold`, `sans-italic`.

## Proposal

- A canvas-level `fonts { name "path/to/font.ttf"; ... }` registers font files under names that `font` then accepts. A program crate reads the files and passes their bytes to the library, which still reads no file itself.
- The math font can be swapped the same way, provided it has a MATH table.
